submission.justification: Absorber-F3 with 5mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.058% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. Systematic simulations across all three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) and plate thicknesses from 2-10mm show that F3 consistently outperforms the other materials, with the optimal thickness at 5mm. This represents a ~40% improvement in resolution compared to Absorber-F1 (best: 5.094% at 4mm) and ~20% improvement over Absorber-F2 (best: 3.819% at 5mm). The resolution curve for F3 shows a clear minimum at 5mm, with performance degrading for both thinner (3.71% at 2mm) and thicker plates (4.455% at 10mm). All candidate materials are compatible with the mechanical support design and readout system according to project documentation.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 at 5mm achieves 3.058% resolution at 100 GeV, which is the best among all tested configurations across all three materials and thickness ranges from 2-10mm

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as one of the three candidate absorber materials

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
